item.title: Gate is damaged/missing/locked problem, 24th November
item.description:
Dear Green Space Development / Customer Services Team, I am writing to formally report an accessibility issue regarding the public gate located at Jersey Avenue (what3words: rapid.poppy.poker) in Cheltenham. On 20th November 2026, I attempted to pass through this gate with a standard pram/pushchair and found the clear opening width was too narrow to fit through safely. As a result, I was blocked from using the public space/path and had to take a lengthy detour. Under the Equality Act 2010, Cheltenham Borough Council has a Public Sector Equality Duty to ensure public parks and open spaces are accessible to all residents. A gate that prevents a standard pram from passing through also creates an unfair barrier for wheelchair users, mobility scooter users, and carers. Could you please: 1. Inspect the gate at Jersey Avenue and measure the clear opening width. 2. Confirm whether this gate meets current accessibility standards (such as BS 5709 for gaps, gates, and stiles). 3. Advise when the gate will be widened, modified, or fitted with an accessible RADAR key mechanism so prams and mobility aids can pass through safely. I look forward to receiving your response and an update on how this will be resolved.
Report on FixMyStreet
